$comment: The model registry (technical-spec §5.3). This file is the registry — the
code that reads it holds no per-model knowledge, so adding a Hebrew model
or a desktop-tier model is an entry here plus a GGUF file, with no change
under features/chat. Phase 3.3 verifies that claim.
The GGUF itself is NOT in git (technical-decisions #19): it is hundreds of
megabytes of binary that git cannot diff. Fetch it with
`dart run tool/fetch_model.dart`, which reads this file, downloads each
model from its sourceUrl and refuses to install one whose sha256 does not
match. At runtime the same digest is re-checked before load (§7.5).
sourceUrl is used ONLY by that tool, never by the app: §8 makes a network
call at runtime a defect, and nothing under lib/ reads this field.
